{"response":{"candidates":[{"index":0,"finishReason":"STOP","content":{"role":"model","parts":[{"thoughtSignature":"","text":"{\n       \"name\": \"Noise-Gated Restart Thresholding\",\n       \"algorithm\": \"Step 1: Check the solver mode. If 'Stable', return the result of the existing reluctant doubling strategy. \\nStep 2: If 'Focused', retrieve the current fast LBD EMA ('fast_avg'), slow LBD EMA ('slow_avg'), and the LBD of the most recently learned clause ('last_lbd'). \\nStep 3: Update a persistent deviation EMA ('dev_avg') using the formula: dev_avg = 0.9 * dev_avg + 0.1 * abs(last_lbd - fast_avg). \\nStep 4: Calculate the volatility ratio 'V' = dev_avg / fast_avg. \\nStep 5: Define a dynamic threshold multiplier 'M'. If V \u003c 0.15 (stagnant), set M = 0.85. If V \u003e 0.4 (volatile), set M = 1.15. Otherwise, set M = 1.0. \\nStep 6: Trigger a restart (return true) only if fast_avg \u003e (M * slow_avg) + (0.25 * dev_avg).\",\n       \"reason\": \"This variant improves Step 6 by incorporating the deviation ('dev_avg') directly into the trigger inequality as an additive noise margin. In the original algorithm, a temporary spike in 'fast_avg' during a high-variance search phase could trigger a premature restart. This reduces thrashing on hard combinatorial instances.\"\n}\n\n\u003ccode\u003e\nbool kissat_restarting (kissat *solver) {\n  assert (solver-\u003eunassigned);\n  if (!GET_OPTION (restart))\n    return false;\n  if (!solver-\u003elevel)\n    return false;\n  if (CONFLICTS \u003c solver-\u003elimits.restart.conflicts)\n    return false;\n\n  // Step 1: Check the solver mode.\n  if (solver-\u003estable)\n    return kissat_reluctant_triggered (&solver-\u003ereluctant);\n\n  // Step 2: Retrieve values (Focused mode)\n  const double fast_avg = AVERAGE (fast_glue);\n  const double slow_avg = AVERAGE (slow_glue);\n\n  // We need to track the deviation of the LBD. Since we cannot modify the solver struct\n  // to add new fields (as per API constraints), we use static variables to track the\n  // state of the deviation EMA and history.\n  static double dev_avg = 0.0;\n  static double prev_fast_avg = 0.0;\n  static uint64_t last_processed_conflicts = 0;\n\n  // Update deviation EMA only when the solver state has advanced (conflicts increased)\n  if (CONFLICTS \u003e last_processed_conflicts) {\n      double last_lbd_est = fast_avg;\n\n      // Estimate alpha based on the EMA window option.\n      // Kissat's actual alpha is dynamic but converges to 1/window.\n      double window = (double) GET_OPTION (emafast);\n      double alpha = (window \u003e 1.0) ? (1.0 / window) : 1.0;\n\n      // Back-calculate the instantaneous input (last_lbd) from the change in EMA.\n      // EMA logic: new = (1 - alpha) * old + alpha * input\n      // Therefore: input = old + (new - old) / alpha\n      if (prev_fast_avg \u003e 0.0) {\n          double diff = fast_avg - prev_fast_avg;\n          last_lbd_est = prev_fast_avg + (diff / alpha);\n          if (last_lbd_est \u003c 0.0) last_lbd_est = 0.0;\n      }\n\n      // Step 3: Update persistent deviation EMA\n      // dev_avg = 0.9 * dev_avg + 0.1 * abs(last_lbd - fast_avg)\n      double current_dev = fabs(last_lbd_est - fast_avg);\n      dev_avg = 0.9 * dev_avg + 0.1 * current_dev;\n\n      // Update history\n      prev_fast_avg = fast_avg;\n      last_processed_conflicts = CONFLICTS;\n  }\n\n  // Step 4: Calculate volatility ratio 'V'\n  double V = (fast_avg \u003e 1e-9) ? (dev_avg / fast_avg) : 0.0;\n\n  // Step 5: Define dynamic threshold multiplier 'M'\n  double M = 1.0;\n  if (V \u003c 0.15)\n      M = 0.85;\n  else if (V \u003e 0.4)\n      M = 1.15;\n\n  // Step 6: Trigger a restart\n  // Condition: fast_avg \u003e (M * slow_avg) + (0.25 * dev_avg)\n  double threshold = (M * slow_avg) + (0.25 * dev_avg);\n\n  kissat_extremely_verbose (solver,\n      \"noise-gated restart: fast=%.2f slow=%.2f dev=%.2f V=%.2f M=%.2f thresh=%.2f\",\n      fast_avg, slow_avg, dev_avg, V, M, threshold);\n\n  return (fast_avg \u003e threshold);\n}\n\u003c/code\u003e"}]}}],"responseId":"u3CKachA5Z7Psg-ric7oBQ","usageMetadata":{"promptTokensDetails":[{"modality":"TEXT","tokenCount":5976}],"totalTokenCount":17713,"candidatesTokenCount":1265,"promptTokenCount":5976,"thoughtsTokenCount":10472},"modelVersion":"gemini-3-pro-preview"},"key":"req-0001","model":"models/gemini-3-pro-preview"}
